demandDecision.meaning: operator, platform, governance and backend-only service baseline in each of TEST and PROD
demandDecision.correction: 23 denotes 16 platform plus 7 operator AWS owners, not 23 stack targets.
demandDecision.decision: Retain legacy ownership checkpoints and their resources; do not run active programs against them. No removal or redeployment merely to improve a score. No new repositories, environments, compute fleet or regions in this review.
demandDecision.catalogDates: Existing lastReviewed fields remain historical; this separate current technical review binds their exact unchanged catalog content without attributing new personal owner review.
demandDecision.cleanupTrigger: Any demonstrated unused owner gets an explicit per-resource dependency/usage and recovery review before a separate deletion plan. Review retained inventory monthly; current migration evidence makes immediate wholesale deletion unsafe.
demandDecision.expansionGate: Recalculate per-kind counts and account/regional quota headroom before any catalog change; preserve Config singleton, existing CloudTrail capacity margin, 100 USD budget, 80/100 percent alerts, 10 USD anomaly and 1 GB/1 USD transfer review triggers.

storageAndPricingDecision.observedLifecycle: TEST primary state and governed service state retain noncurrent versions 365 days and abort multipart uploads after 7 days; central logs transition after 30 days and expire after 365. Rules read live, not inferred from source.
storageAndPricingDecision.accessModel: Interactive small JSON current checkpoints use STANDARD; replicas remain STANDARD for recovery and are outside the synchronous apply path. Recovery snapshots/journals are bounded cold review copies, not a new application data stream. Do not transition authoritative active checkpoints into retrieval-delayed tiers.
storageAndPricingDecision.growthModel: Three current TEST checkpoint samples total 2442370 bytes; these are samples, not whole-bucket size. Growth follows completed updates and retained versions, so watch monthly version bytes and writes per active target rather than multiplying 23 retained owners by active stack fanout.
storageAndPricingDecision.performanceLimits: Replica samples prove current version/size/ETag parity only, not achieved latency or an RPO/RTO SLA. Daily Backup and eventual replication remain design assumptions; successful restoration is separately unresolved.
storageAndPricingDecision.pricingReview: Keep existing storage classes pending actual size/access evidence. STANDARD_IA has 128 KB minimum billable size, 30-day minimum duration and retrieval/transition charges; do not claim savings for tiny log objects or force a new transition. No purchase/reservation or region change.

incrementalProdGovernancePlan.interpretation: 40 Pulumi AWS records include 2 bucket containers plus their configurations, 1 KMS key/alias, 2 secrets/versions and 6 roles plus policies/attachments. Do not count every record as a separate billed service. This was reviewed plan inventory, not a completed PROD governance deployment at this review cut.

storageAndPricingDecision.projectionAssumptions: One newly created customer-managed KMS key at 1 USD/month plus two Secrets Manager secrets at 0.40 USD/month each before usage and future rotation charges; no duplicate charge for SecretVersion resources. Service baseline program exports configuration only and declares zero AWS resources. Already installed operator/platform/TEST governance resources are not added again.
storageAndPricingDecision.variableCostModel: Add regional S3 current+noncurrent+replica GB-month, PUT/GET/LIST/replication requests and cross-region transfer, KMS API and Secrets Manager API requests. These depend on actual workload volume; 1.80 is a fixed-charge component, not a complete forecast or spending cap. Existing actual/forecast budget and anomaly/transfer limits provide stop-and-review thresholds.

technicalIncidentTabletop.scenario: primary state unavailable or ambiguous write
technicalIncidentTabletop.checks: Verify exact account/backend, current VersionId and locks; compare pinned recovery receipt without fallback init/import.
technicalIncidentTabletop.containment: Stop writers and preserve sealed evidence; no blind retry of ambiguous mutation.
technicalIncidentTabletop.recovery: Use separately reviewed version-bound ownership recovery. Actual PROD conditional-delete 501 stopped, reconciled and exact owned versions were released with preserved 21/77 owners; no bucket outage injected.

technicalIncidentTabletop.checks: Three fresh TEST source heads COMPLETED and replica heads REPLICA matched version/ETag/size; recheck source head unchanged.
technicalIncidentTabletop.containment: Keep primary authoritative; do not promote a stale replica or create duplicate owners.
technicalIncidentTabletop.recovery: Re-establish replication/parity before promotion; no regional failover or measured recovery SLA claimed.

technicalIncidentTabletop.scenario: KMS disablement, pending deletion or policy regression
technicalIncidentTabletop.checks: Existing live operator/governance key-state, rotation and exact policy receipts; compare immutable key/provider bindings.
technicalIncidentTabletop.containment: Stop plans when key/provider/config binding fails; no passphrase/local-state fallback or guessed broad decrypt Allow.
technicalIncidentTabletop.recovery: Restore only reviewed exact key policy/state through authorized operator; actual KMS/Secrets Manager repair and negative IAM simulations are evidence, not an injected key-disable exercise.

technicalIncidentTabletop.checks: Current role/trust/boundary and protected environment receipts; inspect caller and source/ref/numeric identity.
technicalIncidentTabletop.containment: Freeze relevant writers; retain deny boundaries and exact subject contracts; no static credential escape path.
technicalIncidentTabletop.recovery: Reapply reviewed exact trust/policy, then real OIDC and negative decision checks. Current downstream main-only protected environments installed; final service promotion still pending.

technicalIncidentTabletop.checks: Live platform logging prefix is outside central policy allow; service prefix matches. Empty listings alone are not proof of failure.
technicalIncidentTabletop.containment: Report real mismatch, preserve CloudTrail selector exclusivity and no silent permission widening.
technicalIncidentTabletop.recovery: Root assigned narrow platform prefix repair; then actual post-apply metadata/delivery verification. This tabletop detected an open defect and does not certify healthy platform logging.

technicalIncidentTabletop.checks: Use real terminal status AND issues/content checks, exact destination ownership, canary event evidence and selector rollback.
technicalIncidentTabletop.containment: No blind retry, no cleanup of unidentified/in-flight restore; keep failure receipts and report remaining resources.
technicalIncidentTabletop.recovery: R3 content+canary cleanup verified by root, delivered Put/Get proof and actual successful restore remain pending. No successful restore inferred from canary or migration.

technicalIncidentTabletop.checks: Bind actual current source, checks, saved plan and protected environment; inspect failed stage rather than its badge.
technicalIncidentTabletop.containment: No bypass to manufacture normal merge; current ruleset bypass list independently verified empty.
technicalIncidentTabletop.recovery: Correct exact runtime/source defect, execute affected checks and fresh plan; final same-head TEST/PROD comment promotion still required.

incidentReviewLimits: Completed delegated technical tabletop and metadata exercise, not a human paging drill or destructive fault injection. Detection/containment/recovery decisions reviewed now. Record source/UTC/account/plan in incident GitHub issue when authorized; keep secret material private. No new external notification sent. Recovery objectives and business communications commitments are not invented; REL9/REL11/REL12/REL13 remain below 5 where actual recovery or service outcomes are missing.
